title: Rc Cache Failures
objective: Validate bounded runtime/native caches and release failure behavior for unwritable, corrupt, interrupted, missing-compiler, and concurrent cases.

handoff.summary: Added a hermetic release cache smoke command and focused regression covering the public module/dynamic cache CLI plus native cold/warm restore, corruption recovery, interrupted publication, bounded cleanup, broad-path refusal, unusable roots, missing compiler recovery, live leases, and concurrent single-publication behavior.
risks: The portable tier was not accepted as a lane receipt because this isolated worktree did not provision optional FLINT artifacts; its cache-independent failures were missing native addons. The smoke itself passed 6/6 on Linux x64 and contains no POSIX-only filesystem operations.
next_steps: The integration lane must add test/release-cache-lifecycle.cjs to test/node-test-manifest.cjs because that shared registry is outside this lane's claims.
Run the smoke from unsigned macOS arm64 and Windows x64 release candidates as part of the coordinated platform validation.
